scope: Two assigned test files only; author rationale for independent root review

findings.reason: One byte-stream contract suite: Content-Length preflight, measured-byte overflow, split UTF-8, fatal decoding, format/body refusal and cancellation ownership are tested via observable real ReadableStream behavior. No application or unrelated subsystems are mocked.

One fixed transport contract suite: literal action URLs and exact request capture, bearer/credentials/cache/redirect policy, real public receiving, no retry and caller/lifetime/deadline disposal. Intercepted fetch is the sole effect boundary; assertions do not mirror production correlation logic.

One canonical minimal receipt suite: detached frozen output, strict allowed/missing fields, opaque credential grammar and exact expiry/clock boundaries. It exercises validation outcomes, not network/bootstrap authority, and deliberately preserves native actor namespace without Clerk inference.
